scope: Approved coordination-model inventory for only four explicitly associated A11/as-20 IPE500 primary members. This is not a fabrication or as-built model.

change_visualisation.meaning: Display-only identification of this development change set. It does not describe steel paint, coating, material, construction status or source confidence.

source_projection.method: Column centrelines are midpoints of opposing IPE500 outer contour edges. Rafter centrelines are midpoints between the opposing IPE500 roof-contour faces; source-graphic interruptions at the internal detail are bridged only along the same labelled continuous member.

IPE500.representation: Nominal rolled IPE profile with idealised profile geometry for coordination; rolling tolerances, camber and connection-specific modifications are excluded.

centreline_definitions_mm.method: Coordinates derive from the calibrated Section_A11_Axis_20 vector projection. Each endpoint is the midpoint between paired IPE500 exterior contour edges. The two rafter upper contours are locally interrupted by a source detail; their end-aligned segments are retained as one source-labelled rafter edge.
centreline_definitions_mm.section_orientation: A11/as-20 is a YZ elevation at X=5150 mm. Nominal IPE500 section height h is in the elevation plane and flange width b is out of plane along X.

A11_20_30.derivation: Midpoints of the A-side IPE500 outer contour edges at Y=-0.000124/499.996418; top Z=9152.971553/9179.739541. Literal label 30 IPE500-S355JR is adjacent to this A-side outer-column contour in AANZICHT as-20.

A11_20_29.derivation: Midpoints of the E-side IPE500 outer contour edges at Y=27329.999079/27829.999930; top Z=9179.743849/9152.971553. Literal label 29 IPE500-S355JR is adjacent to this E-side outer-column contour in AANZICHT as-20.

A11_20_21.derivation: Midpoints between the A-side lower IPE500 contour edge [Y=517.996845/Z=8692.004658 to Y=13894.132246/Z=9408.157118] and the end-aligned upper contour edge [Y=520.866229/Z=9192.875803 to Y=13897.001630/Z=9909.023954]. Literal label 21 IPE500-S355JR is adjacent to the A-side sloped contour in AANZICHT as-20.

A11_20_25.derivation: Midpoints between the E-side upper IPE500 contour edge [Y=13933.002484/Z=9909.023954 to Y=27309.133577/Z=9192.875803] and lower contour edge [Y=13935.871868/Z=9408.157118 to Y=27311.998652/Z=8692.004658]. Literal label 25 IPE500-S355JR is adjacent to the E-side sloped contour in AANZICHT as-20.

explicitly_not_inferred: No HEA200, IPE300, IPE240, IPE200, HEA180, K-profile, CN profile, WVB85x5, base plate, connection, stiffener, secondary steel or mirrored member is included.
No regular repetition to another structural station is inferred.
No fabrication definition or as-built claim is made.
